title: Everyone Ai
one_liner: Self-service AI workspace platform for launching Claude Code environments via Kubernetes.
what_it_is: A portal that allows team members to launch isolated VS Code workspaces backed by Claude Code without local setup. It manages Kubernetes pods, ingress routes, and workspace templates through a web interface and CLI.
how_its_built: Node.js Express backend serving a vanilla JS SPA, deployed on k3s via Helm. Uses Traefik for ingress and standard Kubernetes APIs for pod management.
how_to_apply: Operators bootstrap k3s clusters using the afterburner CLI and deploy the portal via Helm. Users connect via VPN, select a template from the catalog, and launch a browser-based IDE.
quickstart:
npx afterburner bootstrap --host <ip> --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
npx afterburner install
helm install everyone-ai-portal ./charts/portal -f profiles/k3s.yaml -f config.yaml --namespace myteam --create-namespace
features: App Catalog with pre-configured Claude Code templates
One-click launch of personal VS Code workspaces
Persistent HTTPS endpoints for deployed targets
Team-wide usage monitoring and fleet overview
CLI for cluster bootstrapping and workspace management
diagram_architecture:
flowchart TD
    User[User VPN] --> Traefik[Traefik Ingress]
    Traefik --> Portal[Portal Server Node Express]
    Portal --> K8sClient[Kubernetes Client]
    K8sClient --> WorkspacePods[Workspace Pods code-server]
    K8sClient --> TargetPods[Target Pods user apps]
